problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate a fixed budget across 15 infrastructure projects to maximize the total projected community benefit.  
The characteristics of each project are as follows:  
* Project A: projected benefit is 0.157, disruption index is 0.017, allocation bounds [0.021, 0.689]  
* Project B: projected benefit is 0.072, disruption index is 0.299, allocation bounds [0.065, 0.309]  
* Project C: projected benefit is 0.057, disruption index is 0.079, allocation bounds [0.052, 0.680]  
* Project D: projected benefit is 0.120, disruption index is 0.123, allocation bounds [0.094, 0.843]  
* Project E: projected benefit is 0.194, disruption index is 0.240, allocation bounds [0.087, 0.792]  
* Project F: projected benefit is 0.139, disruption index is 0.197, allocation bounds [0.054, 0.358]  
* Project G: projected benefit is 0.074, disruption index is 0.155, allocation bounds [0.074, 0.667]  
* Project H: projected benefit is 0.090, disruption index is 0.290, allocation bounds [0.023, 0.801]  
* Project I: projected benefit is 0.039, disruption index is 0.245, allocation bounds [0.007, 0.338]  
* Project J: projected benefit is 0.144, disruption index is 0.290, allocation bounds [0.074, 0.790]  
* Project K: projected benefit is 0.108, disruption index is 0.015, allocation bounds [0.049, 0.369]  
* Project L: projected benefit is 0.179, disruption index is 0.108, allocation bounds [0.002, 0.657]  
* Project M: projected benefit is 0.099, disruption index is 0.108, allocation bounds [0.091, 0.669]  
* Project N: projected benefit is 0.054, disruption index is 0.219, allocation bounds [0.062, 0.338]  
* Project O: projected benefit is 0.026, disruption index is 0.128, allocation bounds [0.024, 0.422]  

Each project must receive a budget share that lies within its specified bounds, and the total allocation across all projects must sum to one.  
To ensure equitable distribution, the set of community-focused projects Q = {F, I, L} must collectively receive at least 0.266 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall disruption index for the entire portfolio must not exceed 0.231, and the total projected benefit must be at least 0.075.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes total projected benefit while satisfying all constraints.
